Discusses signed and unsigned branch comparisons, not byte loads or extension.
Identifies an unsigned-byte load and separately lists byte-extension instructions, but does not explain how byte loads extend to register width.

grades.quote: LH loads a 16-bit value from memory, then sign-extends to 32-bits before storing in _rd_ . LHU loads a 16-bit value from memory but then zero extends to 32-bits before storing in _rd_ . LB and LBU are defined analogously for 8-bit values.
grades.reason: Directly establishes that signed byte loads sign-extend and unsigned byte loads zero-extend to the 32-bit register width.
